div.head: IV As 2
div.ab: Et hoc inprimis est, ut obseruentur omnia iudicia, quę apud Grateleiam posita fuerunt, preter mercatum ciuitatis et diei dominice.
[De judiciis observandis, quæ apud Greateleiam edita fuerunt.] Et hoc inprimis est, ut observentur omnia iudicia, quæ apud Greateleiam posita fuerunt, præter mercatum civitatis et diei Dominicæ.
And first of all; all the decrees shall be observed, which were established at Grately except those which relate to trading in a town and trading on Sunday.

note.label: abrogates
note.quote: the clause ('24:1') banning Sunday trading, its absence logically connected with the deliberations at Thunderfield ('IV') that abrogated previous decisions about Sunday business

note.label: revises (lifts ban)
note.quote: Within a few more years, however, the king seems to have changed his mind. The ban on Sunday commerce was apparently lifted.

note.label: refers to
note.quote: VI As 10 says that obedience was pledged to what had been enacted at Grately, Exeter, Faversham and Thunderfield, 'except for what was there previously struck out'

div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann. Liebermann compares II As 24.1; 12.

note.seg: II As 12. 24, 1 hob also noch Æthelstan selbst auf, und VI 10 zitiert diese Aufhebung. Handel am Sonntag (s. d. Gl 5) wird später wieder verboten, auch VIII Atr 17
II As 12. 24, 1 was thus repealed by Æthelstan himself, and VI 10 cites this repeal. Trading on Sunday (see that word in Gl 5) is later forbidden again, also VIII Atr 17
See II As. cap. 24 § 1. In later times trading on Sunday was again forbidden (see VIII Athlr. cap. 17).
